name: OmniEarth-Bench
description: A benchmark suite for evaluating models on Earth observation and geospatial understanding tasks across multiple modalities (e.g., satellite imagery, multispectral data, and textual metadata). It measures performance on tasks such as land-cover classification, object detection, segmentation and captioning relevant to remote-sensing applications.
reputation: A smaller/anon-hosted benchmark for multimodal Earth observation tasks with limited community visibility compared to major remote-sensing benchmarks.
